item.title: OpenClaw 2.0 Just Made AI Coding MULTIPLAYER 🤯 #Shorts
item.description:
OpenClaw 2.0 is here: the open source AI agent harness shipped its biggest release ever, with 933 contributors and over 16,000 pull requests merged. The headline feature is shared cloud sessions, so an entire team can work inside one AI agent instead of one harness per developer. Creator Peter Steinberger says local harnesses feel like relics of the past now, but reviewers note sandboxing and command approvals ship off by default, so teams should lock those down before rolling it out.

item.title: How to Make ChatGPT Codex Remember Your Preferences (Step by Step)
item.description:
How to make Codex remember your preferences: tell ChatGPT Codex your formatting and style rules once, and every new chat starts with them.
If you use OpenAI Codex at work, you probably retype the same instructions all day. Use this layout. Keep the tone plain. Here is the one sentence that ends that loop. You say remember this going forward, and Codex saves your preference into a plain text AGENTS.md file on your computer. Every new chat reads that file first, so your house style is set before you ask. You can also open the file and edit it yourself, like a notepad.
